title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: pay-as-you-go billing for Other AI apps indicators (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its government-cloud target, consumption billing and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the subscription-linking instructions, acknowledge conflicting consent-role documentation, cite the Worldwide roadmap item and identify the consent step missing from the controls table.
